card.name: Words just before a person noun
card.fires_on: Small linking or modifying words right before a word for a person, such as man, girl, individual, student, launderer or worker. Examples are 'a young', 'traced to', 'one-armed', and 'given to'.

modes.label: Adjective before person
modes.description: A describing word after 'a' that leads into man, girl or similar.
modes.example: a<< young>> man who appeared mysteriously in the streets

modes.label: Link before a person
modes.description: A word like to or or that leads into a person or group as the recipient or actor.
modes.example: A tip or gratuity is an amount of money that is given<< to>> a worker such as a waiter or

modes.label: Role modifier
modes.description: A modifier inside a job or role title, just before the role noun.
modes.example: mechanical engineering<< doctoral>> student Stuart J. Williams

card.writes: It seems to suppress soul, souls and minds, which are person-like nouns, so it steers the next word away from those.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before a person is named or described, like the 'young' in 'a young man'.
